actions.cancel_event.description: Cancels a scheduled meeting in SavvyCal.
actions.cancel_event.props.event_id.desc: The unique ID of the event to cancel. You can find this from the output of a trigger or the List Events / Get Event actions.
actions.create_event.description: Books a meeting on a scheduling link at a specific time slot.
actions.create_event.props.attendee_emai: Email address of the person booking the meeting.
actions.create_event.props.attendee_name: Full name of the person booking the meeting.
actions.create_event.props.custom_fields: Additional questions configured on the scheduling link (e.g. Company, Why are we meeting?). Filled in dynamically based on the selected link.
actions.create_event.props.end_at.descri: The End date and time of the meeting
actions.create_event.props.link_id.descr: Select the scheduling link to book a meeting on.
actions.create_event.props.metadata.desc: Custom key/value pairs to attach to the event. Useful for tracking the source flow or correlating with external systems.
Attendee's phone number in international format (e.g. +15555555555). Required only if the scheduling link asks for it.
actions.create_event.props.start_at.desc: The start date and time of the meeting. Must match an available slot on the scheduling link.
actions.create_event.props.team_id.descr: Filter scheduling links by team. Leave empty to show all teams.
actions.create_event.props.time_zone.des: Attendee's local time zone in Olson format (e.g. America/New_York, Europe/London, Africa/Lagos).
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_scheduling_link.descripti: Permanently deletes a scheduling link from your SavvyCal account.
actions.delete_scheduling_link.props.lin: Select the scheduling link to delete. This action cannot be undone.
actions.delete_scheduling_link.props.tea: Filter scheduling links by team. Leave empty to show all teams.
actions.duplicate_scheduling_link.descri: Creates a copy of an existing scheduling link.
Select the scheduling link to duplicate.
Filter scheduling links by team. Leave empty to show all teams.
actions.find_events_by_email.description: Returns all events where the attendee's email matches the given address.
actions.find_events_by_email.props.atten: The email address of the attendee to search for.
actions.find_events_by_email.props.start: Only search events starting after this date. Use this to limit the search scope and improve performance.
Only search events starting before this date.
actions.get_current_user.description: Retrieves the profile of the currently authenticated SavvyCal user.
actions.get_event.description: Retrieves the details of a specific scheduled meeting by its ID.
actions.get_event.props.event_id.descrip: The unique ID of the event. You can find this in the event URL in SavvyCal, or from the output of a trigger or List Events action.
actions.get_link_slots.description: Returns available time slots for booking on a scheduling link. Useful for displaying availability or for picking a slot before calling Create Event.
actions.get_link_slots.props.link_id.des: Select the scheduling link to query slots for.
actions.get_link_slots.props.team_id.des: Filter scheduling links by team. Leave empty to show all teams.
actions.get_scheduling_link.description: Retrieves the details of a specific scheduling link by its ID.
actions.get_scheduling_link.props.link_i: Select the scheduling link to retrieve.
actions.get_scheduling_link.props.team_i: Filter scheduling links by team. Leave empty to show all teams.
actions.get_workflow_rules.description: Returns the rules configured for a specific workflow.
actions.get_workflow_rules.props.workflo: Select the workflow whose rules you want to retrieve.
actions.list_events.description: Returns a list of scheduled meetings from your SavvyCal account.
actions.list_events.props.limit.descript: Maximum number of events to return. Leave empty to return all matching events.
actions.list_events.props.link_ids.descr: Only return events booked through the selected scheduling links. Leave empty for all links.
actions.list_events.props.start_after.de: Only return events that start after this date and time.
actions.list_events.props.start_before.d: Only return events that start before this date and time.
actions.list_events.props.states.descrip: Filter events by their current status. Leave empty to return all statuses.
actions.list_events.props.team_id.descri: Filter scheduling links by team. Leave empty to show all teams.
actions.list_scheduling_links.descriptio: Returns all scheduling links configured in your SavvyCal account.
actions.list_scheduling_links.props.team: Filter scheduling links by team. Leave empty to show all teams.
actions.list_workflows.description: Returns all workflows configured in your SavvyCal account.
actions.toggle_scheduling_link.descripti: Switches a scheduling link between active and disabled states.
actions.toggle_scheduling_link.props.lin: Select the scheduling link to toggle.
actions.toggle_scheduling_link.props.tea: Filter scheduling links by team. Leave empty to show all teams.
description: Scheduling tool that lets invitees overlay their calendar when picking a time.
triggers.new_event.description: Triggers when a SavvyCal event occurs. Select one or more event types, or leave empty to trigger on all types.
triggers.new_event.props.event_types.des: Select which event types to trigger on. Leave empty to trigger on all event types.
triggers.new_event.props.link_ids.descri: Only trigger for events on the selected scheduling links. Leave empty to trigger for all links.
triggers.new_event.props.team_id.descrip: Filter scheduling links by team. Leave empty to show all teams.
triggers.new_poll_response.description: Triggers when a poll response is created or updated in SavvyCal.
triggers.new_poll_response.props.event_t: Select which poll response types to trigger on. Leave empty to trigger on all poll response types.
triggers.workflow_action_triggered.descr: Triggers when a workflow action is triggered in SavvyCal.
